primaryTextChecks.text: Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.

context.text: He had forty sons and thirty sons’ sons who rode on seventy donkey colts. He judged Israel eight years.
